items.why: Caught in the AI debt unwind: CoreWeave bonds now yield about 15%, reviving worries that debt-funded data center spending could slow. AMD reports Nov 3; Citi lifted its target to $800 on Oct 6.
Fear gauge eased after hitting a two-week high yesterday. Stocks stabilized off their lows and Treasury yields fell, trimming demand for downside protection.
Rebounded with risk assets after a hot PPI reading (6.3% YoY) first pushed it below $80,000. Easing yields and dip buying lifted it back toward $82,000.
Tech lags as the AI trade wobbles again. CoreWeave slipped on debt concerns while Tesla and lower oil prices propped up the broader market.

market_note: Dow futures point up while Nasdaq futures sag; markets await Fed Chair Warsh's speech today.
summary: Stocks are bouncing back from yesterday's AI-led selloff as Treasury yields ease, but tech still lags on worries about debt-funded AI spending. Bitcoin recovered from its brief dip below $80,000.
